+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_users_by_ids(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    """Return the users with one of the requested ids."""
+    raw_ids = params.get("ids")
+    if not isinstance(raw_ids, list) or not 1 <= len(raw_ids) <= 20:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid ids"}
+    user_ids = []
+    for raw in raw_ids:
+        if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isascii() or not raw.isdecimal():
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid ids"}
+        user_ids.append(int(raw))
+    return 200, {"users": users.get_users(user_ids)}
